items.name: Green Concept
items.summary: Winner of Best Multi-Family Residential Development in Uruguay. Three low-rise buildings joined by a park in Carrasco, under the promoted housing regime. Phase 1 is 85% sold and Phase 2 is on sale.

intro: An urban retreat to experience our philosophy in a tangible, intimate and revealing way.

Imagine coming home feels like arriving at the beach, birdsong is your soundtrack and nature invites you to connect with your senses all day long. Imagine a new way of living, where your daily routine unfolds in contact with different natural landscapes.
gc.pillars_intro: We promote flexible interiors, interaction with the immediate surroundings and a permanent bond with nature. And at the center, the community that lives there.

pillars.title: Home flex
pillars.text: Flexible interiors that adapt to every stage and every way of living.

pillars.title: Home around
pillars.text: Everything you need within a few blocks: schools, shops, sports and entertainment.

pillars.title: Home nature
pillars.text: A permanent bond with nature, inside and outside your home.

project_text: Bordering a linear park and surrounded by a well-kept setting, Green Concept is a development of three low-rise buildings with green surroundings and a green core.
Contemporary architecture by RMA Arquitectura that respectfully integrates its surroundings and brings them inside.
location_text: Green Concept is connected to the main educational, shopping, sports and entertainment centers within a ten-block radius.
Walk or bike, rely less on the car and gain time for what you enjoy most.
gc.apartments_text: 1, 2 and 3-bedroom units joined by a park designed down to the last detail. Views of the park, the woods or the sea, with modern design, quality finishes and nature always present.
gc.partnership_text: Dwell Developers partners with Chilean firm Boreal Developments to bring to Carrasco a concept proven successful in Santiago.
gc.cta_text: Book a meeting with our sales team or visit the project website to see floor plans and availability.

award.title: Best Multi-Family Residential Development in Uruguay
award.text: Green Concept was recognized at the International Property Awards, one of the most prestigious distinctions in the real estate industry worldwide. An independent panel of experts reviews projects from around the world and honors those that stand out for design, quality and innovation.
award.edition: Americas Property Awards 2026-2027 · in association with International Property & Travel

stages.title: Three phases. A sales success.
stages.text: The project is under construction and is being developed in three phases. Phase 1 is already 85% sold and Phase 2 is now on sale.

promoted.title: Tax benefits for buyers
promoted.text: Green Concept is a Promoted Housing project under Uruguayan Law No. 18,795, so buyers have access to tax benefits established by law.
points: Exemption from property transfer tax (ITP) on the purchase
For buy-to-let investors: income tax exemption on rental income for 10 years
promoted.note: Ask our sales team about the conditions that apply to your case.

highlight.title: A garden at the center of your life
highlight.text: The three buildings embrace an inner garden designed by Fernando Bianco: winding paths, lush planting and places to meet, just steps from your door.

items.name: Zen Pueblo Jardín
items.summary: Residential neighborhood with 24-hour security, clubhouse, pool, cowork and generous green spaces.
overview: A neighborhood with a potential of 215 homes, including 92 town houses built under horizontal property in four modules and up to 120 apartments.
A project that meets an unserved demand: young couples or small families who want to keep living in Carrasco.
financing: 100% of the committed capital has been contributed and a 75% pre-reservation was obtained on the first 46 houses.
Several local banks showed interest in financing construction; however, the model foresees self-financing for any funding requirement beyond the capital originally raised.
performance: The project is under construction: earthworks are complete and work is underway on the neighborhood's infrastructure.

items.name: Nuevocentro Towers
items.location: Luis Alberto de Herrera Ave., Montevideo
items.summary: Two 25-storey towers integrated with Nuevocentro Shopping. Delivered four months ahead of the contractual deadline.
overview: Nuevocentro Towers is a complex of 440 apartments in two blocks of ground floor plus 25 levels, with a parking level and fully equipped multipurpose rooms.
The towers share their lot with Nuevocentro Shopping, with direct access to all its services, and special permits were obtained to exceed the height allowed in the area.
The project is complete, with all units delivered to their owners.
financing: Financing came from a public issue acquired by República AFAP, securing 100% of the funds from the start and allowing the project to follow its planned financial schedule.
Nuevocentro Towers was República AFAP's first real estate investment project. The land was acquired through negotiation with the developers of Nuevocentro Shopping.
performance: Timeline: no negative deviations; construction finished four months ahead of the contractual schedule.
Economic: no deviations from the initial commitment.

items.name: Oxo Parques
items.summary: 27 apartments with gym, sauna and pool with solarium. 100% pre-sold before construction began.
overview: Oxo Parques is a complex of 27 apartments in two blocks of ground floor plus three levels, with a parking level and shared spaces.
The project is complete, with all units delivered to their owners.
financing: Financing came directly from the trustors who, as this was an at-cost trust, are the end users.

100% of the units were pre-sold before construction began, and development was funded through monthly payments until completion. The land was reserved in advance and paid with the first three contributions.
performance: Timeline: no deviations from the initial commitment.
Economic: the deviation stayed within normal parameters for this type of development, below 4%.
